daemon.name: Daemon
daemon.detail: no daemon can run here: the IPC socket path /var/folders/20/jp1_0n3n7kndh6rnbqb5344m0000gn/T//axo-gate-b.q98qQh/doctor-none/.axocoatl/run/axocoatl.sock is too long: 107 bytes, and a Unix socket path may have at most 103 bytes on this system
daemon.fix: Set AXOCOATL_SOCKET_PATH to a shorter absolute path, or use a shorter home directory (the path is $HOME/.axocoatl/run/axocoatl.sock), then start one: `axocoatl dev`, or `axocoatl service install` and `axocoatl service start`. The socket's directory must be one only you can write to (it is made if missing), and every axocoatl command must see the same AXOCOATL_SOCKET_PATH (`axocoatl service install` records it for the Always-On Service)
